creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`swift test` reports 319 tests either way, so nothing but a hand-written line says `ClickRedriveTests` still exists after it was moved out of the default gate (`a_2Jrhh1dkA`).

`./dev` prints that line today. It does not generalise: a second such suite needs a second hand-written line, and the day somebody forgets, a suite silently stops running and the gate stays green.

The script already fails a suite that discovers zero tests. Something similar for "declared but not run" would close the gap - a manifest of suites expected to be skipped, checked against what actually skipped, so the count and the reality cannot drift.
title: 🙈 A test suite that skips itself is invisible in the run count
